blocks.text: Enzymes ki darja-bandi (classification) un reactions ki bunyad par ki jati hai jo woh catalyse karte hain aur un substrates ki bunyad par bhi jo woh istemal karte hain.

blocks.alt: Enzymes ki chhe classes ka table, har aik ke reaction ki chhoti tasveer aur misalon ke saath: oxidoreductases (H aik molecule se doosre par; dehydrogenases, oxidases), transferases (group aik molecule se doosre par), hydrolases (A-B + H2O se A-H + B-OH; peptidases, lipases), lyases (CO2 jaisa group pani ke baghair alag), isomerases (molecule apne isomer mein) aur ligases (A + B + ATP se A-B + ADP + Pi).
blocks.caption: Enzymes ki darja-bandi un ke reactions ke lihaz se (Figure 5.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Reaction ki aam qisam ke mutabiq enzymes chhe classes mein baante jate hain.

items: Oxidoreductases apne substrates ka oxidation ya reduction catalyse karte hain, H+ ions ya electrons shamil ya khatam kar ke. Maslan cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ka oxidation catalyse karta hai.

Transferases ek makhsoos functional group (maslan methyl, acyl, amino ya phosphate) ko ek substrate se doosre tak muntaqil (transfer) karne ko catalyse karte hain. Maslan hexokinase ATP se glucose ko phosphate group muntaqil karta hai.

Hydrolases hydrolysis reactions catalyse karte hain, pani shamil kar ke apne substrates ko monomers mein torte hain. Maslan lipase, amylase, peptidase aur doosre hazme ke enzymes khuraak ke molecules ki hydrolysis catalyse karte hain.
Lyases substrates se groups (maslan CO2 ya NH2) ka ghair-hydrolytic shamil ya khatam hona catalyse karte hain. Maslan pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO2 nikalta hai.
Isomerases molecule ke andar dobara tarteeb catalyse karte hain, ek isomer ko doosre mein badal kar. Maslan hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose mein badalta hai.

Ligases woh reactions catalyse karte hain jin mein do molecules naye C-C, C-N, C-O ya C-S bonds bana kar jurte hain, ATP ki tawanai istemal kar ke. Maslan polymerase enzymes ATP istemal kar ke monomers jorte hain.

items: Proteases proteins ka tootna catalyse karte hain. Pepsin aur trypsin bare polypeptides ko chhote polypeptides mein torte hain; aminopeptidases chhote polypeptides ko dipeptides mein torte hain, aur erepsin dipeptides ko amino acids mein.
Lipases lipids par kaam karte hain aur un ka tootna catalyse karte hain. Pancreatic lipase lipids ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein hydrolyse karta hai.

Carbohydrases bare carbohydrates par kaam karte hain aur unhen chhoti ikaiyon mein torte hain. Amylase starch ya glycogen ko maltose mein torta hai; cellulase cellulose ko cellobiose (ek disaccharide) ya glucose mein; maltase maltose ko glucose mein, sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein, aur lactase lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein torta hai.
Nucleases nucleic acids par kaam karte hain aur un ka tootna catalyse karte hain. RNAase, DNAase aur ATPase bil-tarteeb RNA, DNA aur ATP torte hain.

blocks.prompt: Har enzyme ko us ki reaction class mein rakhen: hexokinase, lipase, pyruvate decarboxylase, cytochrome oxidase, hexose isomerase, DNA polymerase. Phir batayen ke lipase aur amylase kis substrate group se hain.
blocks.explanation: Hexokinase: transferase. Lipase: hydrolase. Pyruvate decarboxylase: lyase. Cytochrome oxidase: oxidoreductase. Hexose isomerase: isomerase. DNA polymerase: ligase. Substrate ke lihaz se lipase ek lipase hai (lipids par kaam karta hai) aur amylase ek carbohydrase.

items: Reaction ke lihaz se chhe classes: oxidoreductases (cytochrome oxidase), transferases (hexokinase), hydrolases (hazme ke enzymes), lyases (pyruvate decarboxylase), isomerases (hexose isomerase), ligases (polymerases, ATP se).

Substrate ke lihaz se: proteases (pepsin, trypsin, aminopeptidases, erepsin), lipases (pancreatic lipase), carbohydrases (amylase, cellulase, maltase, sucrase, lactase), nucleases (RNAase, DNAase, ATPase).
